title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 21: the burden of the wilderness of the sea, the watchman's cry that Babylon has fallen, and the burdens of Dumah and Arabia.

questions.text: Isaiah 21 opens with the burden of what?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 opens with "The burden of the wilderness of the sea," coming like whirlwinds in the South.

questions.text: Which nation is told, "Go up... attack!"?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media's sighing."

questions.text: What are the speaker's pains compared to?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says pains have seized him, like the pains of a woman in labor.

answers.text: The pains of a woman in labor

questions.text: What are the princes told to rise up and do?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, "Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!"

questions.text: What did the Lord tell the speaker to set?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, "Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees."

questions.text: What does the watchman see coming?
questions.explanation: Verses 7 and 9 say he sees a troop of men, horsemen in pairs, with troops of donkeys and camels.

answers.text: A troop of men, horsemen in pairs
A pillar of smoke from the city

questions.text: What is announced about Babylon in verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground."

questions.text: In the burden of Dumah, what question is called out of Seir?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says one calls out of Seir, "Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?"

questions.text: The inhabitants of which land met the fugitives with their bread?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread and brought water to the thirsty.

questions.text: Within a year, whose glory will fail?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says, "Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail."
